full_prompt_en: A square monochrome pen-and-ink illustration presents a pale young woman's three-quarter profile surrounded by tightly interwoven flowers, leaves, lace, and ornamental forms. A thin dark rectangular border holds the busy arrangement just inside the image edge. The woman occupies the left center, her face turned toward the left with a downcast, thoughtful gaze. Her light cheek and forehead remain mostly clear paper, with delicate gray modeling around the eyelid, nose, and parted lips. Short curling locks frame the temples and cheeks, while a patterned head covering or jeweled band blends into the floral structures behind her hair. An elongated earring hangs near the jaw. At the lower right, dark clothing with a curved pale border and a row of small circular decorations creates a strong black counterweight to the bright face. Around the head, large pale blossoms, patterned leaves, curling vines, and ribbon-like scrolls overlap so densely that no plain background remains. A rounded dark ornamental shape sits behind the right side of the head, partly lost among the flowers. The near-white face and blossoms are separated by dark pockets and masses of fine hatch marks, preventing the intricate pattern from flattening into one tone. Every surface appears drawn with thin line, stipple, and short crosshatching; the figure's smooth skin contrasts with the busy fabric and plant textures. Light is decorative and broadly even, with the palest paper areas acting as illumination and deep ink clusters supplying shadow rather than a physical cast. The overall composition is ornate and intimate, giving a calm, softly modeled profile room to breathe within a tightly woven black, gray, and ivory pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色钢笔墨线插画呈现一名浅色面容年轻女子的四分之三侧影，周围密密交织花朵、叶片、花边和装饰形体。一道细深色矩形边框把繁忙结构收在画边内侧。女子占据左侧中央，面部朝左，目光低垂而若有所思。浅亮面颊和额头大多保留纸白，眼睑、鼻子与微张嘴唇周围有细微灰色塑形。短卷发围住太阳穴与面颊，带花纹的头饰或珠饰带融入发后花形结构。下颌附近垂着一枚长耳饰。右下方深色衣装有弯曲浅边和一排小圆饰，与亮脸形成强烈黑色配重。头部周围，大朵浅色花、带纹叶片、卷藤和丝带般涡卷叠得极密，几乎没有素净背景。一个圆润深色装饰形在头的右后方，局部消失于花丛。近白的面孔和花朵由深色缝隙及大量细排线分开，使繁复图案不至压成同一灰调。所有表面都像由细线、点描和短交叉排线绘成；人物光滑皮肤与繁忙织物及植物肌理对照。光线具装饰性、整体均匀，最浅纸白区域充当照明，浓墨块提供阴影，而非真实投影。整体构图华丽而亲密，让平静柔和塑形的侧影在紧织的黑、灰、象牙色图案中获得呼吸空间。
style_prompt_en: The pen-and-ink illustration sets a smooth pale focal area inside a dense lattice of flowershaped curves, fine hatching, stipple, and dark ornamental masses. Monochrome ivory, gray, and near-black are distributed in alternating pockets, so the eye can move through high detail without losing the central hierarchy. Thin contours resolve small shapes precisely, while larger black passages provide rest and weight. Repeated curls and scallops make a continuous decorative rhythm within a narrow border. Light is broadly even and represented by reserved paper white; depth comes from overlap, ink density, and a few gently graded central surfaces rather than realistic perspective or cast shadow. The overall finish is intricate, antique, and intimate, balancing visual abundance with one calm open value field.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅钢笔墨线插画把光滑浅色焦点放在由花形曲线、细排线、点描和深色装饰大块组成的密格中。单色象牙、灰与近黑交替分布成大小色窝，使视线能穿过高密细节，又不失中央层级。细轮廓精确收束小形体，较大黑色区域提供喘息与重量。重复卷纹和波纹在狭窄边框内形成连续装饰节奏。光线整体均匀，由预留纸白表达；纵深来自叠压、墨色密度和少数中央表面的轻柔渐层，而非写实透视或投影。整体完成面繁复、古旧而亲密，以一片平静敞开的明度区域平衡视觉丰盛。
theme_en: A pale woman's profile surrounded by intricate monochrome flowers and ornaments
theme_zh: 一名浅色面容女子的侧影，四周围满繁密单色花饰与纹样
name: Vania Zouravliov
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
